results.reasoning: Judged on a scratch copy (one registered project, one blueprint) served at :4732, driving the panel in a browser through all three cases. Root (/): the modal alone over the desk ruling, frame display:none, bar and panel visibility:hidden, no Close button, Escape and a backdrop click leave it standing (01). Arrival on an unclaimed page (the copy's blueprint claims :4700, so :4732/stand-in/project-modal misses on the port): the frame loads the page and the panel stands beside it with zero tabs and the one line 'Please select a project…', both blurred; the modal names the address, says 'No blueprint claims this page.', puts `walkdown claims --url <address>` under MAKE THIS PAGE REVIEWABLE and `walkdown import <path>` / `walkdown init` under OR BRING A PROJECT IN above the list, and cannot be dismissed (02). With 25 cloned rows the commands stay put and only the list scrolls (03). Nothing opened by default with a single blueprint; choosing it opened the board (04). The switcher from the bar reuses the same modal and the same backdrop - computed backdrop-filter blur(8px) with a transparent background in every case, no dim - with the board blurred behind it (05), and a backdrop click gives frame, tabs and rules list back byte-identical (07). The failure: Escape does not close the switcher. With the Close button focused, a real keypress and a synthesized keydown both left the modal open (06, probe.txt); the panel's single document Escape handler in src/panel/app.js covers evidence, screen picker, desk tuner and pin mode but never fires close-projects, and projects.js closes only on backdrop click or the Close button. The rule says the switcher 'gives it back on Escape' and the step names Escape explicitly, so that is a miss, not a nuance. Not exercised: several projects claiming one page and a server that lists nothing - with one registry entry the first is unreachable, and `walkdown serve` with an empty registry refuses to start at the CLI (it names init and import there), so the in-panel empty-list case has no live path from this setup. Filed as n-0279.
